title: Small studio: resources, processes and values

scale.policy: At most five distinct participating people per scenario; a person with several capabilities still counts once.

people.name: Owner / game director
people.notes: Creative direction is declared. No art/programming capability, willingness for a particular assignment, or sprint capacity is inferred.

tools.support: studio access unverified; repository can hold source

processes.label: Brief → contribution → review → exact build selection
processes.status: partly specified; #146 proposes local submission; shared review/build selection planned

processes.label: Director records review of an exact revision
processes.status: Proposed manual process; no recorded review session or accepted game revision.

values.rule: The owner chooses creative direction and game artwork. AI assists with decomposition, coordination, generic implementation and verification; proposed creative choices require owner selection.
Keep planning practical for one to five people; expand a work item only when needed for assignment, a meaningful blocker or acceptance.
A resource must be both capable and willing/available. Unknown is not a commitment.
Separate claimed capability, tool implementation, available inputs, completion, review and build selection.
Keep original private archives, assets, dialogue, source and DLLs local. This plan contains summaries only.
